verdict.rationale: MotherDuck is a SaaS data warehouse, so an interactive API reference is a fair question to ask of it. The pack shows no interactive API explorer with runnable examples. The probe found an OpenAPI spec file, but a raw spec is a building block for such a reference, not the interactive reference itself. Instant SQL previews are a SQL IDE feature, an adjacent capability rather than an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
